message: Inspected real server request lifecycle and wrote design document docs/specs/admin-working-correction-liveness-design.md (currently uncommitted; committing shortly) per your instruction. Key discovery: all current MCP tool commands cross Server/McpTools.fs:McpToolHelpers.send and ClientService.SendCommandToUser, so per-user/agent in-memory admission gate is feasible; however ClientResponseTracker drops correlation on timeout, ClientService can return timeout while client still executes, and existing SQLite FeedbackStore operations row is marked completed on server request return (not client terminal). FeedbackStore.BeginOperation is best-effort and currently omits agent/device IDs. A plain ephemeral server gate is thus unsafe across restart or ambiguous client delivery. Recommend extending *existing* SQLite operation telemetry as conservative persistent in-flight/indeterminate veto with authenticated client terminal receipts and an exclusive correction-path gate; Git remains only task authority. No automatic clearing of unknown disconnected/child jobs. Gate keys by user+agent across project aliases until verified canonical project IDs available. Also fixed 555/556 client regression: verified registered unassigned Parked/NeedsWork agents can self-inbox; unknown bound agent still fails closed. Targeted 2/2 pass, full client running. Please advise if persistent SQLite liveness witness is acceptable (not trust-state authority).
